title: 第7章 开始教姬云生凡人武学第8章 开始教姬云生凡人武学2
content_zh:
太阳初升时，没一会儿，陈明也起来了，来到院中打算活动活动，看到两人后，缓缓走过来笑着问道：“晓云，你难道没有带弟弟回房间休息吗？”陈晓云摇摇头，笑着温柔说道：“爹爹，你可不知道，弟弟我才教了他一夜识字，他已经把基础的文字都学会了。
而且还有件怪事，按道理弟弟如今没有踏入修行，除了是婴儿状态，会有凡人该有的身体情况外。有一件事就很奇怪，就是好像弟弟的精神不是如此，就和修炼之人一般，不睡觉都有精神。”陈明一听也陷入思考起来，过了一会儿，笑着问道：“
晓云，你觉得这是什么情况呢？”陈晓云见状摇摇头，温柔笑着回答道：“爹爹，我也不知道弟弟是什么情况，毕竟我如今也才筑基修为，只有等回去宗门后，让师尊亲自查看一番才会知道了。不过这样也好，弟弟如今已经学会基础文字了，我或许可以尝试教弟弟开始修炼了。”
陈明一听连忙笑着说道：“晓云，不可，如今你弟弟还没有测试过，你就直接教他修炼的话，万一功法不契合的话，会坏了他的修炼根基的。”陈晓云一听，温柔笑着说道：“爹爹，我知道，我也只是先打算教弟弟凡人武学而已。先让弟弟学习后，只是强健体魄打下根基，
这样的话，等宗门测试后，在教弟弟修炼之法。”陈明一听明白了，笑着回答道：“那就好，那就好，只是如此这般的话，倒还是不错。毕竟一个人的上限，取自一个人的体魄能承受能量的多少，没有强大的体魄，就算能修行也走不了多远。”
姬云生一听，心里喃喃道：“我也是醉了，这用陈叔你说啊，要是体魄不够强的话。要是服用什么天材地宝，能量太强的话，可是会被撑爆的啊！”陈晓云一听，温柔笑着问道：“弟弟，怎么样？姐姐现在就教你凡人武学，为你今后修炼打下结实的基础。”
姬云生一听点点头，陈晓云见状把姬云生递给陈明抱着后，温柔笑着说道：“爹爹，你就先抱着弟弟，让他看着我教他的凡人武学。等弟弟什么时候，能够自己行走时，就能开始自己修炼起来了。”陈明一听笑着回答道：“嗯，晓云，你开始吧。”
又对着姬云生笑着说道：“云生，你可要看好姐姐教你的武学了，要是有不懂的话。等你开始能够修炼时，你就问你姐姐，想来那时候，你也能开口说话了。”姬云生点点头，满是认真的看着陈晓云，陈晓云开始了准备动作，温柔笑着说道：“弟弟，可要看好了，
姐姐先教你最常见的凡人武学中比较强大的一本，名为《霸王拳》的功法。”当她说完后，也缓慢开始了展示，姬云生也是静静看着，在陈晓云的缓慢一招一式下，那拳法都是掀起一阵阵微风，姬云生心里喃喃道：“我去，这拳法还真简单，真是有劳晓云姐了，
如此缓慢的展示着，就算换个傻子来都能学会吧。看来还是不能小看凡人武学，要是在地球的话，也不知道那些网上的大师，能不能做到如此。一招一式之中，都能随着动作带起气势，还能伴随动作掀起微风，这简直真是厉害了。也不知道，真正的修炼之法会如何了？
恐怕应该是和小说那般如此了，强大的修炼者，能一刀断江河，一掌灭山峰等等吧。”时间过得很快，才一炷香时间，这《霸王拳》就已经被陈晓云缓慢施展了一遍了，她连忙跑来温柔笑着问道：“弟弟，姐姐刚才的这套功法，你学会了吗？”
姬云生连忙点点头，陈晓云见状也是又震惊了，心里喃喃道：“这弟弟看来有可能是灵级天赋了，不然的话，不可能会在我才施展一遍过后就学会了。虽然不是传说中的仙级或神级天赋，但要是灵级的话，以后也能成为一方强者了。”陈明也是吃惊了，
感慨笑着说道：“晓云，看来云生的天赋确实强大，就以你而已，你当初学会一种凡人武学，都是看爹爹教了你不下十遍才学会。”陈晓云温柔笑着回答道：“嗯，弟弟天赋确实强，真有可能比我还强。”姬云生心里喃喃道：“我去，这是什么情况，陈叔、晓云姐你们可别骗我，
这一遍就记住功法动作，难道就代表天赋强了？就这速度，我就算在地球学习不好，也能记住了，毕竟我又不是弱智。”
content_en:
When the sun first rose, Chen Ming got up soon after and came to the courtyard to plan some activities. After seeing the two of them, he slowly walked over and asked with a smile: "Xiaoyun, didn't you take your brother back to the room to rest?" Chen Xiaoyun shook his head, smiled and said softly: "Dad, you don't know, I just taught my brother how to read overnight, and he has already learned all the basic characters.
And there is another strange thing. It stands to reason that my younger brother has not entered into cultivation now. In addition to being in an infant state, he will have the physical conditions that a mortal should have. One thing is very strange, that is, my brother's energy is not like this. He is just like a cultivator, he is energetic even if he doesn't sleep. Chen Ming also fell into thinking upon hearing this. After a while, he smiled and asked: "
Xiaoyun, what do you think this is going on? "Chen Xiaoyun shook his head when he saw this, and replied with a gentle smile: "Dad, I don't know what is going on with my brother. After all, I have only just established my foundation and cultivation. I will only know after I return to the sect and let the master check it out in person. But that’s okay. My brother has now learned basic writing. Maybe I can try to teach him to start practicing. "
When Chen Ming heard this, he quickly smiled and said, "Xiaoyun, no, if your brother hasn't been tested yet, if you teach him to practice directly, if the skills are not suitable, it will destroy his training foundation." Upon hearing this, Chen Xiaoyun said with a gentle smile: "Dad, I know, I only plan to teach my brother mortal martial arts first. After letting my brother learn first, I will just strengthen his body and lay the foundation.
In this case, after the sect's test, he will teach his younger brother how to practice. Chen Ming understood it as soon as he heard it, and replied with a smile: "That's good, that's good, but that's it, it's not bad." After all, a person's upper limit is determined by how much energy a person's body can withstand. Without a strong body, even if you can practice, you won't be able to go far. "
When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he murmured in his heart: "I am also drunk. Let me tell you, Uncle Chen, if you are not physically strong enough. If you take some heavenly material and earthly treasure, if the energy is too strong, it will burst!" Upon hearing this, Chen Xiaoyun asked with a gentle smile: "Brother, how are you? My sister will teach you mortal martial arts now, laying a solid foundation for your future practice."
Ji Yunsheng nodded upon hearing this. Chen Xiaoyun handed Ji Yunsheng to Chen Ming and said with a gentle smile: "Dad, just hold your brother first and let him watch the mortal martial arts I teach him. When my brother can walk on his own, he can start practicing on his own." Chen Ming smiled and replied: "Well, Xiaoyun, you can start."
Then he smiled at Ji Yunsheng and said: "Yunsheng, you have to pay attention to the martial arts taught by your sister. If you don't understand anything. When you start to practice, you can ask your sister. I think you will be able to speak by then." Ji Yunsheng nodded and looked at Chen Xiaoyun seriously. Chen Xiaoyun started to prepare, and said with a gentle smile: "Brother, be careful.
My sister will first teach you the most common and powerful technique in mortal martial arts called "Bawang Fist". "After she finished speaking, she slowly began to demonstrate. Ji Yunsheng also watched quietly. With Chen Xiaoyun's slow moves, the boxing skills set off waves of breeze. Ji Yunsheng murmured in his heart: "I'll go, this boxing method is really simple. I really have Sister Lao Xiaoyun.
Demonstrating it so slowly, even an idiot would be able to learn it. It seems that mortal martial arts should not be underestimated. If we were on earth, I don't know if those online masters could do this. Every move can generate momentum along with the movement, and it can also create a breeze along with the movement. This is simply amazing. I don’t know what will happen to the real method of cultivation?
I'm afraid it should be like the novel, where a powerful practitioner can cut off rivers with one sword, destroy mountain peaks with one palm, etc. "Time flies by so quickly.In just one stick of incense, Chen Xiaoyun had slowly performed the "Overlord Fist" once. She quickly ran over and asked with a gentle smile: "Brother, have you learned the set of exercises that my sister just did?"
Ji Yunsheng nodded quickly. Chen Xiaoyun was shocked again when he saw this, and murmured in his heart: "It seems that this younger brother may have a spirit-level talent. Otherwise, he would not have learned it after I used it once. Although it is not a legendary fairy-level or god-level talent, if it is a spirit-level talent, he can become a strong person in the future." Chen Ming was also surprised.
Smiling with emotion, he said: "Xiaoyun, it seems that Yunsheng's talent is really strong, and it's just you. When you first learned a mortal martial arts, you only learned it after your father taught you it no less than ten times." Chen Xiaoyun replied with a gentle smile: "Well, my brother's talent is indeed strong, he may be stronger than me." Ji Yunsheng murmured in his heart: "I'll go, what is going on, Uncle Chen, Sister Xiaoyun, don't lie to me,
Just remembering the exercises and movements this time, does it mean that you have strong talent? At this speed, even if I don't learn well on Earth, I can still remember it. After all, I'm not mentally retarded. "
